supporting_pages.title: "Query and filter data \_|\_ Firestore in Native mode \_|\_ Google Cloud\
evidence_snippets: To control the number of results returned, use a limit clause or paginate your query . array-contains-any Use the array-contains-any operator to combine up to 30 array-contains clauses on the same field with a logical OR .

You can't combine array-contains with array-contains-any in the same disjunction. in , not-in , and array-contains-any Use the in operator to combine up to 30 equality ( == ) clauses on the same field with a logical OR .
From the example data, this includes the SF , LA , DC , and TOK documents. not-in Use the not-in operator to combine up to 10 not equal ( != ) clauses on the same field with a logical AND .
